scope: Architecture design catalog; zero executable module adapters.

items.name: General value function / 多预测知识
items.contract_focus: Cumulant, target policy, continuation and termination define the prediction question; behavior-policy support and off-policy correction are explicit.
items.measurement: Causal prediction/calibration by horizon plus controlled downstream usefulness.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Temporal abstraction / option
items.contract_focus: Initiation set, intra-option policy, termination, interruption and primitive-time credit are separate contracts.
items.measurement: Actual option duration, reliability, primitive-step reward and equal-budget controls.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Subgoal discovery and selection
items.contract_focus: Goal representation, reachability, intrinsic target, hindsight relabeling and lower-policy nonstationarity are explicit.
items.measurement: Achievability and external-return improvement beyond random/manual subgoal controls.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Predictive or control representation
items.contract_focus: State abstraction declares which decisions/values it preserves and under which data distribution.
items.measurement: Aliasing interventions, prediction/control error, transfer and resource-matched controls.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Persistent history state
items.contract_focus: Reset, burn-in, history credit, checkpoint consistency and deployment persistence are declared.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Learned transition or value-relevant model
items.contract_focus: Observed/imagination data are separate; model target, rollout policy and versioned snapshot are declared.
items.measurement: One-step and multi-step errors, policy-ranking/value error, shift adaptation, downstream return.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Decision-time search or Dyna-style planning
items.contract_focus: Separate planning-time action selection from background value learning; count simulation calls and model privilege.
items.measurement: Matched-data/matched-compute improvement, latency, model exploitation and search-depth sensitivity.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Online control of learning updates
items.contract_focus: Targets, controllable operators, delayed feedback, credit and actual deployment timing are explicit.
items.measurement: Counterfactual microdiagnostics and independently confirmed raw-return improvement.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Multi-agent coordination
items.contract_focus: Per-agent observations/actions/messages, centralized training privilege, partner identities and shared state are explicit.
items.measurement: Independent joint-lifetime repeats, partner transfer, communication and centralized-information controls.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.

items.name: Architecture scheduler and persistent lifecycle
items.contract_focus: Owns atomic snapshot/restore, event order, resource budgets and boundaries; it is not itself an established algorithm.
items.measurement: Deterministic event traces, failure injection, whole-architecture cost and downstream return.
items.evidence_boundary: Reference algorithm evidence does not validate a new combination or this workbench module.
